findings.passage: that the stars at the top "are terrified that someone's coming up behind them," so "you're going to spend your whole life looking over your shoulder. I never wanted that."
findings.problem: S07 (Wayback 2021 copy) reads: "The guys who are on top are terrified that someone's coming up behind them. If that's your real ambition, to be on top all the time, you're going to spend your whole life looking over your shoulder. I never wanted that." The author's "so" replaces his conditional about the ambition to stay on top, turning it into a consequence of other stars' fear. Both fragments are verbatim and the gist survives, but this is the lead quotation for the Six exposure thread.
findings.acceptance_test: The sentence either restores "if that's your real ambition, to be on top all the time" (as a quotation or an accurate paraphrase) or drops the connective "so", so that the looking-over-your-shoulder line reads as the cost of wanting to stay on top, which he says he never wanted.

His stated preference is a say in the outcome, not letting go. The trim favors the rival type, so it does not inflate the thesis, but it is the same kind of same-breath cut the jury flagged in the other direction.
findings.acceptance_test: Either a clause notes that when he can, he prefers to be involved in post-production (S16), or C111's inference records why the clause is omitted. The quoted words stay verbatim.
